name: OversizePermitTracker
tagline: Every oversize permit, every jurisdiction on the route, every escort – before the load rolls.
description: Complete oversize / overweight permit app for heavy-haul carriers and permit desks: one permit per jurisdiction and move, dimensions against configurable legal limits, escort, police and route-survey requirements, superload lead time, route coverage with one-click drafts for missing jurisdictions, drag-and-drop permit pipeline, validity timeline, record issue / extend / start travel with business rules, route sheets, CSV and Power Fx outputs and events – for canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Legal limits per jurisdiction (over-width / height / length / weight)
Escort, height-pole, rear-escort and police rules
Superload detection with survey and lead-time checks
Route coverage per move with gap detection
Add missing permits in one click
Record issue, amend, extend, reject, cancel
Start / pause / complete travel with checks
